claims: Generation Z were born between 1997 and 2012.
As of 2026, Generation Z are roughly 14 to 29 years old.
Nearly 50% of Generation Z are racial/ethnic minorities.
Generation Z has never known a world without smartphones and social media.
Generation Z use TikTok and Instagram as primary search engines.
Generation Z is the most diverse generation.
Data shows a sharp increase (45% in 2025) in Generation Z getting married.
Data shows 23% more Generation Z having children
